{"question":"What actions must a manager take both before and during a team member’s participation in ElevatePrep to ensure successful engagement?","answer":"A manager must first approve the team member’s participation and confirm support during enrollment, and then during the program discuss benefits, manage workload, encourage application of skills, and help ensure attendance of all sessions.","evidence_a":"Participation in Elevate Prep requires:
1. Manager approval
1. Active interest in developing leadership skills
1. Ability to commit to all four sessions

During our Open enrollment sessions, team members must meet with their managers to confirm support in joining the next ElevatePrep cohort. This helps ensure participants have the support needed to fully engage in the program. Managers and People Business Partners can also nominate participants to join an ElevatePrep cohort.","evidence_b":"Managers with team members participating in ElevatePrep should:
1. Discuss the program's benefits and expectations during 1:1 meetings
1. Support team members in managing their workload to accommodate program participation
1. Provide ongoing encouragement and opportunities to apply learned skills
1. Help ensure participants can attend all sessions
1. Complete a short Pre-program survey (sharing expectations and focus areas for their direct report) and a Post-program survey about 4–6 weeks after completion (sharing observed behavior changes and ongoing support needs)"}
